demand: Shared database impact from migrations and backend query consumers.
identitySummary: Database namespace, schema, table, column, and enum names with PostgreSQL identifier folding.
compatibilitySummary: Table/column/enum removal and bounded type, nullability, and enum-value changes are classified without a database connection.
evidenceRendering: Exact producer and consumer paths, ranges, immutable hashes, versions, activation, coverage, and rollout remedy.
limitations: Initial SQL parsing supports bounded PostgreSQL DDL and literal DML forms only.
Dynamic SQL, stored procedures, generated migrations, and unresolved connection aliases remain partial coverage.
Prisma client calls require immutable model-to-table mappings in adapter context.
